10010201.t: Harmony Pavilion
Aberrant spirits had taken over the Harmony Pavilion and were making a racket.
Haha, quite the commotion.
At this rate, customers won't even be able to come in.
They're disrupting business. Guess we should kick them out.
Hmm... We could, but look at them...
Doesn't it look like they just want to play?
What do you think, my friend?
Join in the fun.
Well, if they want to play, let's play!
All right! Hehe... Let me show them how it's done!
A moment later...
Hmm? Where are you going, children?! The cups haven't even cooled yet!
...That's a first. Spirits drinking themselves into the afterlife.
Teach them a lesson.
Leave it to me, my friend! I'll put them to rest in one fell swoop!
...I thought you were going to put them to rest?
Hmm... Brute force isn't working on them. It must be the corrupting power.
My friend, what should we do?
Don't ask me.
Well, we're out of luck...
Brute force wasn't going to work...

10010202.t: Sky Lantern Street
Aberrant spirits are disrupting a puppet show.
Uninvited guests... and there's no part for them in the show.
At this rate, the puppet show will be ruined.
Well, isn't this kind of neat in its own way? Like an interactive play or something.
I doubt aberrant spirits understand puppet shows, but...
They seem curious about what it is, though.
What do you want me to do, <:player>?
Play the hero of justice.
...Do I really have to?
They want to play, so let's play along. What have we got to lose?
Now, make way for Kouchou, the Magical Shrine Maiden of Justice!
I gave you a script! Stick to it!
I-In the n-name of l-love and j-justice...
I will... send you back to where you belong!
U-Ugh...?! H-Haaahn...!?!?
Apparently, they weren't satisfied with Kouchou's acting.
Kouchou was thoroughly ravaged by the aberrant spirits...
Play the enemy-turned-ally.
Oh, the horror! Evil creatures threaten the festival! How will our brave exorcists save the day?!
H-Hmph, don't get the wrong idea. It's not like I'm on your side or anything.
It's just that I'm the only one who gets to defeat you!
Ooh! Here comes Magical Shrine Maiden Kouchou! Can she turn the tide?!
With our hearts united... Evil spirits, begone!!
Kouchou and the members united their hearts and unleashed their ultimate move!
Satisfied with the show, the aberrant spirits passed on in peace...

10010203.t: Sky Lantern Street
Aberrant spirits have taken over the shooting gallery, blocking the targets.
No one can play like this.
We should drive them off at once.
How?
They say people have used artillery to drive off evil spirits since ancient times.
Luckily, I brought some Kunoichi-style C4. Just in case.
...What kind of "just in case" makes you bring C4 to a festival?!
Anyway, they seem to be having fun, don't they? Hmm...
They certainly do.
What would you like to do?
Drive them off with artillery
Are you sure that'll work? Should we give it a shot?
Heh... Don't worry. Kunoichi engineering is second to none. Everything will go exactly to plan.
First, separate the explosives... connect the detonator... insert a straw into the shuriken...
And then?
That's all I'm going to explain.
You might try it yourself. That would be dangerous.
Ah, fair enough.
Wait... They're watching you. Is that okay?
Ngh?! W-Wait! Don't touch that! The fuse isn't connected yet, so...
W-Whoa! Don't mess with the explosives...!
Ah. So that's how this ends...
Use them as targets
Wait... I think we can use this.
Use what?
Time to show off those Kunoichi skills.
Here's the plan... (whisper whisper) We do this... (mumble mumble)
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm. I see... Oh, like that...?
A moment later...
Hey, aim better! Isn't shooting part of the Kunoichi exam? Did you fail?
I didn't fail! This isn't the kind of gun I usually use... It's throwing off my aim...
Kage, adjust the difficulty!
Understood... Kunoichi Technique: Shadow Bind!
Is this my chance?!
Nice... Let's keep this up.
Hehe... Only you would put a Kunoichi to work like this.
Still... It's an excellent plan. I'm impressed.

10010204.t: Hundred Schools of Thought Classroom
Aberrant spirits have taken over the Hundred Schools of Thought Classroom.
Help me, <:player>! Forget teaching—my classroom's turning into a house of horrors!
That doesn't sound so bad either.
Hey! How is that helpful?!
Anyway, what do we do? I never learned how to deal with ghosts...
How is it any different from a normal class?
Whaaat?
Looks to me like they just want to attend class.
When it comes to learning, it doesn't matter whether they're human or a ghost, right?
Yeah... If they're here to learn...
Then the Hundred Schools of Thought should teach them, human or ghost.
In that case... what kind of class should I teach?
Teach a serious class
Got it! All right, open your textbooks. Today's lesson is...
Huh? You don't get it? Hmm... But this is as basic as it gets...
Let's see... Then how about this? An introduction to philosophy even a monkey can understand!
Whaaat?! You don't get this either...?
Anyone could pick up this stuff on their own...
H-Huh...? D-Didn't you like the lesson...?
Aaah! W-What are you doing?! You want that kind of lesson...?!
That's not my subject, so... Ahhh! N-Not there...!
Th-This wasn't in the lesson plaaan!
The lesson ended with Hari being thoroughly ravaged by the aberrant spirits...
Slack off
Then class is in session! Time for some fun with Teacher Hari!
Ferry Landing
...Huh? We're having class here?
You bet! This is hands-on fieldwork!
You're just happy to skip class, aren't you?
Hehe, it's all about how you look at it, right?
Today, we're doing "Catch-Whatever Fishing"!
Catch-whatever fishing...?
Yep! Fish, time, people... You can catch all sorts of things!
It's all in how you see things, and what you take from them...
That's where philosophical insight comes from.
You know, that almost makes sense...
And so, Hari and the aberrant spirits enjoyed a spot of fishing...
Huh...? Where did they go?
Looks like they found enlightenment while fishing and moved on to the afterlife.
Whaaat?! Then all that teaching was for nothing!
I'd say that's a sign you taught them pretty well...

10010205.t: Aberrant spirits have occupied the park benches.
Taking over a public park... I can't let this slide.
They need to learn to follow the rules, aberrant spirits or not.
How? Can you really reason with those delinquents... I mean, delinquent spirits?
Education is about teaching people how to behave in a civilized society. With the right lessons, even an aberrant spirit can become a respectable citizen.
How would you teach these troublemakers, <:player>?
Give them a stern talking-to.
Very well. It's my duty to set wayward spirits straight... I'll give them a piece of my mind.
Listen here! You're giving all aberrant spirits a bad name. Do you realize that?
To be accepted into society, you need to follow its rules, and...
Ack...!? Wh-What do you think you're doing...!?
Wait... Is the disciplinarian getting "disciplined"?!
Don't just stand there! Do something... Ngh!
W-Wait! Not here! Public indecency is...! Hnnngh...!
Jia ended up getting thoroughly ravaged by the angry delinquent Aberrant Spirits...
Turn it into a turf war.
You punks! What are you doing here?! This is our turf!
Exactly! Leave at... Wait, what?! This is a public space!
Ngh... Are they even listening?
(Hey, just shut up and leave it to me. I've got a plan.)
(You have a plan...?)
(What's that supposed to mean? Got a better way to get through to them?)
(W-Well, not really, but...)
Then keep quiet and follow my lead.
Hey, if you're gonna squat in someone else's spot, you gotta pay a fee, right? Huh?!
W-Why are you provoking them?!
What do you think? Teaching them how harsh the world can be.
Go, Violent Teacher! Give 'em the same beating you give Hari!
I am NOT a violent teacher!
A moment later...
Whew... *huff*... Ready to listen... to your teacher now...?
Well, I guess that's one way to enjoy your youth.

10010206.t: Apparently worn out from playing, the aberrant spirits lay sprawled across Sky Lantern Street, blocking the way.
Oh dear... Don't lie out here like that... You'll wake up with a crooked mouth...
Would you care to get up?
They're not moving. Are they dead...? Wait, they're aberrant spirits...
They seem to have used up most of their spiritual energy.
Um, Fixer... Perhaps we could take them to the hot springs?
A hot spring?
Yes... Quartet's hot springs are wonderful for restoring spiritual energy.
Even aberrant spirits might recover their ki with a soak in the warm water...
All right, let's go.
Here we are.
Um... Fixer, I was going to wash up...
Watch
Sure. I'll watch. Go ahead.
I-It's embarrassing when you stare like that...
Come on. We've already seen everything.
That's true... Hehe... It's embarrassing, but... as you wish, Fixer...
Shall we go in...?
What?! What happened?!
Ah...! Everyone, what's wrong...?
Oops... This is their first time in water this hot, isn't it?
I should've let it cool down before sending them in.
Bathe together
What do you mean? I've come all this way. Of course I'm getting in!
We've seen it all before. What's there to be embarrassed about?
Hehe... Well, as you wish, Fixer... My body may be nothing special, but... look all you like...
Shall we go in together...?
...! Whoa, hold on.
!? What is it, Fixer?
Wait, isn't that water way too hot?
Chise, you go in first.
Hehe... Of course.
Phew...♡
All right, all clear. Why don't you guys hop in too?
Now... Let me gently wash you... with this warm water...
I'll help. Though I have no idea how to wash an aberrant spirit...
Chise and I carefully washed the aberrant spirits, one at a time.
Hehe... Did you enjoy... the hot springs?
That was absolute paradise.

10010207.t: Aberrant spirits were loitering in front of the Blissful Trading Guild's shop, disrupting business.
Fixer! Fixer! Help! These aberrant spirits won't stop blocking my shop...
...You're still here?
Of course I am! I said I was stepping out for a moment, not leaving for good!
Fine. But I'm only buying the cheap stuff this time.
...Haggling already?! How cruel! *Sob*... You're breaking this poor maiden's heart!
With how much money I've spent here so far, negotiating this much is only fair.
Ugh... So this is karma...
That's why you need to run your business honestly, responsibly, and with a conscience. Earn a little trust!
Ahaha! Never heard of any of those!
Anyway, what's the problem?
As you can see...
I try to bring in customers, but the aberrant spirits cling to me and scare everyone off! And I can't exactly sell to spirits...
I was originally only planning to sell to you, Fixer... but at this rate, I'll end up with the lowest sales in the Blissful Trading Guild!
Hmm...
Drive them away
We can't let these punks ruin your business. Let's chase them off.
Really? How?
Their energy's surging right now. Brute force won't work.
Why not give them a few things and send them on their way? They seem interested in your stock.
Ugh... Fine. Maybe a few cheap things will keep them happy...
All right, that's one problem solved.
That's our Fixer! Finally, back to busi—wait. Huh?
More?! No way! I'll be losing money!
Besides, the Blissful Trading Guild doesn't sell to just any—
Oh my... Now that I look closer... Is it me you're after, not the merchandise?
W-Wait! I-I'm not for sale... Ah, aahhhnnn...!?
It seemed giving them goods had backfired on me...
Hire them as employees
The best way to deal with aberrant spirits... is with aberrant spirits.
Aha! An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, and an aberrant spirit for an aberrant spirit, right?!
So... Who wants a temporary job with the Blissful Trading Guild?!
Just keep the customers in line and chase off the troublemakers!
A moment later…
Step right up! Deals like this don't come around every day! Special sale! Everything must go!
Wow! You were right, Fixer! Business is booming!
Don't forget my cut, okay?
Heh... I suppose I have no choice. I'll give our Aberrant Spirits a reward too!
Oh... Give me some too. What is it?
This is incredibly rare! It's none other than a special lotion from the Harmonix Faith, a Vermont specialty! Just applying it makes your skin so soft and smooth, you know?
...Huh? The Harmonix Faith...?
After applying the lotion, the Aberrant Spirits felt their newfound softness and passed on peacefully...
...Well, they got their reward, so I guess there's no problem?
